programmes.d: Key players in the case of Rod Covlin, a New York man who is found guilty of murdering his wife for her $5.3 million fortune and attempting to frame his then-teenage daughter, share their stories.
Police investigate whether the murder of a South Florida attorney is connected to a web of fraud, betrayal and more than $1 billion in missing money.
When hikers find a 21-year-old UCLA student's body in a Los Angeles-area train tunnel, detectives wonder if Ron's interest in an alternative religion is connected to his murder.

The question of a surgeon's whereabouts remains unanswered for five years after he disappears while on vacation in the Greek Islands with his wife, leaving behind financial ruin and mounting malpractice suits from patients in the U.S.
New insights into the real story of the very private royal, including a look at Diana's troubled marriage, her turbulent life in the royal family and the investigation into her death.
An in-depth look at the journalists who exposed the dangers of cult leader Reverend Jim Jones; interviews with witnesses to murders carried out by Jones' followers.
An aspiring Playboy model is brutally murdered in Miami after visiting a nightclub with her boyfriend.
Two decades after a woman falls to her death, police reopen the case and arrest her husband.
A mother, who seemed to be happily married, was found dead in her backyard spa.

After New Jersey mother Michelle Lodzinski reports that her 5-year-old son has vanished from a carnival, detectives embark on a decadeslong investigation until a family member identifies a key piece of evidence pointing to a potential suspect.
The investigation into the death of Spokane, Wash., businessman exposes a web of malevolence extending from the Pacific Northwest to a North Dakota oil field.
After finding his wife and two children dead, a former Indiana state trooper spends 13 years trying to clear his name.
When a man claims to have found his wife dead in the bathtub, the woman's daughters suspect there may be more to the story.
A woman's DNA test sends her father halfway around the world to confront his past.
A car belonging to a missing man erupts in a blaze, leading to clues regarding his whereabouts.
After disappearing for a decade with a convict, officials question the deputy warden's wife's role in his escape.

Investigators from Fort Worth, Texas, desperately search for answers after 17-year-old Carla Walker is kidnapped and murdered following a Valentine's Day dance; cutting-edge DNA technology and diligent police work lead detectives to her killer.
A San Diego mother suddenly vanishes in 2014; nearly two years later, her body is found in the San Diego Bay, but medical examiners say she has only been dead for a month or two.
When a pathologist is found murdered in his home, the investigation reveals simmering jealousies and a love triangle.
Nearly 40 years after a high school senior is found stabbed to death in her car after visiting the mall days before Christmas, investigators identify the killer.
Robert Davis, who was convicted of murdering a woman and her son, claims his confession was coerced and tries to prove he is innocent.
A mother searches for answers in the unsolved murder of her 14-year-old daughter until new DNA technology changes everything.
